name: Lack
overview: Scripture reveals that God faithfully provides for His people, assuring that those who fear the LORD and seek His kingdom will not experience lack or want (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 34:9-10; Matthew 6:31,33). The righteous are sustained by the LORD, who prevents their souls from famishing, contrasting with the fate of the wicked (Proverbs 10:3). This provision extends beyond physical needs, encompassing spiritual sustenance and motivation, while also addressing relational and faith-related deficiencies such as lack of love and faith.
